Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Web Designer position on the Tendem project at Mindrift. With a strong background in web design, UI, and conversion-focused layouts, I am eager to bring my skills to create high-quality, implementation-ready web designs that align with your brand ecosystem.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my ability to design and build responsive WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring clean layouts and clear visual hierarchy. I have also developed a multi-page website for mirook.com, where I designed the entire user experience, from wireframes to final implementation, and integrated social media and structured data to enhance visibility. This project demonstrates my capability to work from rough concepts and deliver polished, on-brand designs.

I am proficient in Figma, including auto-layout and design systems, and I understand the importance of preparing files for seamless developer handoff. My experience with SEO and GEO has given me a user-centric, conversion-minded approach to design, ensuring that every layout prioritizes clarity, white space, and modern web trends. I am also skilled in translating brand assets across different touchpoints, maintaining consistency between web pages, PDFs, and social materials.

I am a self-directed professional who thrives in remote, independent work environments. I am comfortable troubleshooting and delivering production-ready assets efficiently. My portfolio, available at mirook.com, showcases my web design work, including landing pages and marketing sites.

I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to contribute to the Tendem project and help develop high-quality AI technologies. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
